data.name: Get Endpoint Request Error Rate Metric
data.description: Can request specific fields by enabling the `fields` query param
data.evaluateGuide:
Retrieves the WhatsApp Flow endpoint request error-rate metric over a lifetime or specified date range. Selects the metric through the fields parameter.
Use for: measuring endpoint errors, checking Flow reliability, retrieving date-range metrics
Not supported: editing Flows, retrieving message analytics, changing metric data

data.name: Return Atlas Search Metrics for One Index in One Specified Namespace
data.description: Returns the Atlas Search metrics data series within the provided time range for one namespace and index name on the specified process. You must have the Project Read Only or higher role to view the Atlas Search metric types.
data.evaluateGuide:
Returns Atlas Search metric time series for one index and namespace on a specified process within a time range. Use it to inspect query and error-query measurements.
Use for: viewing Search metrics, analyzing query errors, monitoring an index
Not supported: changing indexes, editing Search definitions, managing database data

data.name: Lists work request errors
data.description: Returns a paginated list of errors for the specified work request.
data.evaluateGuide:
Returns a paginated list of errors associated with a specified OCI work operation, with sorting and page controls.
Use for: inspecting operation failures, paging through errors, sorting error records
Not supported: creating operations, retrying failures, changing database resources

data.name: Lists all available failure detection parameter sets | maturity=EARLY_ADOPTER
data.evaluateGuide:
Lists the available failure-detection parameter sets in Dynatrace configuration. Use the response to discover selectable detection settings.
Use for: discovering parameter sets, reviewing failure-detection options, preparing configuration
Not supported: applying settings, editing services, retrieving runtime metrics

data.name: List Metrics
data.description: Lists the metrics that can be exported.
data.evaluateGuide:
Lists metrics available for export from AWS Resilience Hub. The endpoint returns the supported metric catalog for export workflows.
Use for: discovering exportable metrics, selecting resilience metrics, preparing monitoring setup
Not supported: exporting metric values, creating applications, changing resilience assessments

meta.q: query application error metrics from a monitoring tool
